visual.title: Two partitions, one volume
visual.caption: The body is swept from the drawn profile. A disk slice is a thin cylinder, a washer slice is a thin annulus and a shell slice is a thin tube. Each readout is the integral of that slice over the interval. Disks and washers share one body about the horizontal axis; the shell body is a second solid about the vertical axis, so its volume is not meant to match theirs.

predict.question: In the shell formula V = 2π ∫ x f(x) dx, what is x?
options: The distance from the axis of rotation
predict.explain: The shell sits at radius x, so its circumference is 2πx. The height is f(x) and the thickness is dx; the radius is the distance from the axis.
